q: What do we know about feat-bsm-thin-file-flag in the bureau-score-migration project?
a: feat-bsm-thin-file-flag marks applicants with no v10 score or fewer than 2 tradelines, 6.4% of the Jan-Feb 2026 cohort (n=71,300). 41% of flagged applicants have no v10 score, which is the gap in find-bsm-thin-file-gap.

q: What came of exp-301, the linear map test, in the bureau-score-migration project?
a: exp-301 cut the v10 versus v8 PSI from 0.31 unmapped to 0.12 with the linear map on the dual-pull test half (n=26,000). That led to dec-bsm-linear-map on 2026-01-29, which dec-bsm-isotonic-map later superseded.

q: What does bsm-app-gbm-v10b use as inputs in the bureau-score-migration project?
a: bsm-app-gbm-v10b uses feat-bsm-score-map-v2 (isotonic-mapped v10 score), feat-bsm-thin-file-flag and the source flag from feat-bsm-score-missing-impute, on the application features of ds-bsm-app-dev-2024.

q: What is the current approval cutoff for application decisions on the v10 scale in the bureau-score-migration project?
a: The approval cutoff is 652 on the v10 scale from 2026-09-01 (dec-bsm-cutover-2026q3), replacing the v8 cutoff of 640. It was set with bsm-cutoff-logit so the approval rate stays at 58%.

q: What AUC and KS did bsm-app-gbm-v10b reach on bureau-score-migration-oot-2026h1, and what did bsm-app-gbm-v8 reach on the same set?
a: bsm-app-gbm-v10b reached AUC 0.80 and KS 0.37 on bureau-score-migration-oot-2026h1 (n=44,800). bsm-app-gbm-v8 reached AUC 0.78 and KS 0.36 on the same set.

q: Why was the isotonic score map adopted in place of the linear map in the bureau-score-migration project?
a: The linear map left PSI at 0.12 on the dual-pull test half, and the tail stayed off. The isotonic map (feat-bsm-score-map-v2, exp-303) brought PSI to 0.06 on the 2026 cohorts, so dec-bsm-isotonic-map superseded dec-bsm-linear-map on 2026-05-29.
